verdict.rationale: Shopify's own help docs list a page titled "Collecting tips with the Shopify POS," which shows tipping is a first-party POS capability. The pack contains only that title, with no detail on how tip prompts are configured. missing for 10: configurable tip percentages, smart tip amounts, custom tip entry, tip prompts shown on the card reader/terminal or customer-facing display, merchant-side configuration documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can configure tipping prompts (percentages, smart amounts, custom tips) collected on the reader or terminal

citations.quote: Collecting tips with the Shopify POS
